paragraphs.text: Drone is creature type that refers to simple, immature, or artificial lifeforms that perform tedious and menial work.

Drones were living yet artificial beings created by the Vedalken of Mirrodin as guards, sentries, and shock troops. Though most likely self-aware, they lacked free will and were the mute, unquestioning slaves of the Vedalken.

There were two varieties of drones: The land-bound wanderguards patrol the entrances and byways of Lumengrid , using their psychic abilities to scan visitors' minds for unwelcome thoughts. They were tall, squat humanoids with bulbous metallic bodies sprouting spindly limbs, no neck, and a small head with huge unblinking eyes.

More common were the hoverguards , similar in appearance to wanderguards, but sprouting enormous gas-filled sacs from their backs that afforded them lighter-than-air flight. Most hoverguards lacked hands, instead, they had long metallic blades jutting from their wrists. Hoverguards doubled as sentries and taskmasters, the low hum of their inner workings a constant reminder to Lumengrid's Neurok slaves that they were under constant surveillance.

At the Battle of the Synod, the Neurok used information stolen from vedalken libraries to disable their wanderguard and hoverguard defenses, causing a decisive blow against the vedalken. During the war against New Phyrexia , the Mirran resistance used hoverguards as spies against their Phyrexian enemies.

Drones is a Eldrazi class that are aligned with colored mana, first printed in Rise of the Eldrazi . Many of these Eldrazi Drones, as well as some spells, produce Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens . These 0/1 colorless creatures can be sacrificed to add —perfect for casting those enormous Eldrazi.

The Eldrazi Drones of Battle for Zendikar , though requiring colored mana to cast, have devoid and are therefore colorless. Some produce Eldrazi Scion creature tokens . These 1/1 colorless creatures can also be sacrificed to add .

Drones make up one of the two major types of mechan , alongside androids. Drones are generally understood to lack any sort of independence or intelligence in contrast to androids, although in practice the line can sometimes be unclear. Edge of Eternities only uses the actual Drone creature type on artifact creature tokens.

In addition to the drones created by the Vedalken and the Eldrazi, there were castes or specialized forms of spikes ( Spike Drone ) and viscerids ( Viscerid Drone ) known as "drones" as well, using the insectoid colony definition, even though no crustacean species create drones by that definition. A surveillance drone ( Searchlight Companion ) was developed in Kamigawa, using the drone type instead of the conventional Thopter .
